subject: Michael Owen
title: Owen's Man Utd top-four prediction

lines.vo: Michael Owen tipped Manchester United for the top four.
lines.footage: Owen punditry clip, studio, neutral lighting

lines.vo: He said it in August. By November, they were in the relegation zone.
lines.footage: Manchester United match, league table graphic

lines.vo: Carrick was sacked on the twelfth. Pochettino took over on a deal to 2029.
Owen now says he can't see United going down. Same confidence as August.
He says relegation would be as big a shock as Leicester's title in 2016. A fairytale in reverse.
He also thinks Pochettino can revive Rashford.
Rashford, for the record, has no Premier League goal this season.
Your mates will never guess this. Match news and betting tips at aboutfootball dot UK.

Man Utd in the relegation zone at the 9 Nov international break after a 4-4 draw with Aston Villa (https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/t-deny-michael-owen-delivers-090000346.html)

Michael Carrick sacked on 12 Nov; Pochettino to a contract until 2029 (https://www.itv.com/news/granada/2026-11-12/michael-carrick-sacked-by-manchester-united-as-pochettino-poised-to-take-over and https://www.football365.com/news/owen-delivers-verdict-man-utd-appointing-pochettino-huge-relegation-claim)
